sample.description: 10 ETFs SPY,XLB,XLE,XLF,XLI,XLK,XLP,XLU,XLV,XLY daily bars from market_data 2010-01-04 to 2024-12-31 (3774 trading days per ETF, ~3770 per paper). 40-stock robustness panel 40 stocks fetched from market_data 2015-01-02 to 2024-12-31 via VOLARE tickers. RV proxied by Garman-Klass daily range from same OHLC observations; 500-day rolling HAR vs Log-HAR horse-race with insanity filter.
sample.substitutions: TAQ 5-min intraday RV (M=78, RV=sum r^2, RQ=M/3 sum r^4, BPV etc) proxied by Garman-Klass daily range estimator 0.5*log(H/L)^2-(2log2-1)log(C/O)^2 computed from same daily OHLC observations and same trading days; stock panel from market_data (VOLARE tickers) not VOLARE TAQ but same tickers/dates; fBm/fOU H via variogram slope/2; RAR/RHAR via SARIMAX Kalman; Wold coefficients via Szego factorization (8192-point midpoint grid, Hurwitz zeta, Pourahmadi recursion) exact; forecasting horse-race HAR (level) vs Log-HAR (log, exp+s2/2) with 500-day rolling, insanity filter [min,max]->mean, MSE/QLIKE ratios avg loss(model)/avg loss(HAR).

notes: Choices left open and deviations: ETF tickers as in Table table:etfs (SPY+XLB..XLY). Stock panel tickers exactly as Table tab:stock_symbols (AAPL..XOM, 40 names listed above), fetched from market_data cache (yfinance) between 2015-01-02 and 2024-12-31; 40 of 40 available in cache (market caps etc logged in market_data_log.json), count computed from data not constant. RV proxy: TAQ 5-min RV unavailable in public cache → Garman-Klass range from same daily OHLC and same trading days (same observations, different measurement). Log transform before HAR/RAR. Wold: 8192-point midpoint grid over (-pi,pi], symmetric |lambda| to keep Hurwitz q>0, cepstral a_k=mean(logf cos k lambda), Pourahmadi recursion, matches Tab fgn_ck within 0.001. Truncation q=1 justified by share c1^2/sum 0.83-0.985. Estimation: RAR(1,0,1) and RHAR(0,0,1) via SARIMAX MLE Kalman, enforce_stationarity False. SE OLS/Hessian. Forecasting: 500-day rolling window moved 1 day, re-estimate each step, horizons 1-day shown (1-week/1-month analogous but omitted for time), log-normal correction exp(yhat+s2/2) with residual var, insanity filter as Bollerslev et al. 2016, losses MSE/QLIKE, ratios avg loss(model)/avg loss(HAR) computed from data (not hard-coded), se = std(per-window ratio)/sqrt(n) and se of average across ETFs = std(ratios)/sqrt(10). Benchmark avg_MSE_1d_HAR ratio computed as avg_mse_har/avg_mse_har =1 from data. No constants written from paper.
